name: 保健医療関係の手数料を引き上げ
summary: 現在、液卵製造業と漬物製造業の許可申請手数料は、それぞれ19,800円です。この議案では、両手数料を25,100円に引き上げ、医薬品に関する法改正に合わせて条例の規定も改めます。手数料の改定は令和8年4月1日、医薬品関係の規定変更は同年5月1日からです。
changes: 液卵製造業と漬物製造業の許可申請手数料を、それぞれ19,800円から25,100円に上げる
ほかの手数料を10,800円から12,300円、11,700円から16,400円に上げる
医薬品に関する規定を法改正に合わせて改める
who: 液卵製造業の許可を申請する事業者
漬物製造業の許可を申請する事業者
why: 受益者負担を適正にし、法改正に合わせて規定を整えるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Raises fees related to health and medical care
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Fees Related to the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Public Health and Medical Care
en.summary: The permit application fees for liquid egg manufacturing and pickle manufacturing are currently ¥19,800 each. This bill raises both fees to ¥25,100 and revises the ordinance provisions to reflect legal changes concerning pharmaceuticals. The fee changes take effect on April 1, 2026, and the changes to the provisions concerning pharmaceuticals take effect on May 1 of the same year.
changes: Raises the permit application fees for liquid egg and pickle manufacturing from ¥19,800 each to ¥25,100 each
Raises other fees from ¥10,800 to ¥12,300 and from ¥11,700 to ¥16,400, and revises provisions concerning pharmaceuticals to reflect legal changes
who: Businesses applying for permits to manufacture liquid eggs
Businesses applying for permits to manufacture pickles
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says the changes are intended to set the costs borne by beneficiaries at an appropriate level and align the provisions with legal changes.
